gen-gf-bellota-gf-shippori-antique: Shippori Antique reads with a single-width skeleton and bowls tipped open toward you. And Bellota brings the standout moment, its s tails dangling loose, every stroke traced as if with one stylus.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-sn-pro: Bellota's s lets its ends dangle well away from the stem, and every stroke looks pulled through a nozzle. SN Pro follows in sans-serif form, its open curves running quietly through the whole alphabet.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-spinnaker: Marker-drawn plainness runs through every Bellota character, giving the heading a blunt, friendly authority. And Spinnaker keeps its counters connected to the outside, so a long page of it moves along without clogging.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-stick:
Bellota takes the top spot with its dangling s and stylus-wide strokes.

Stick follows below in tubelike, constant-weight lines, with exits wide enough to pass light, so the heading's quirks get room to show.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-suse: Rope-thick curves, loose and friendly. SUSE gives the body open bowls tipped toward you, and Bellota above it adds a dangling-tailed s that makes the heading unmistakable; a modest size gap between them is plenty.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-telex: Bellota is the showpiece here, its strokes pulled like solder through a nozzle and its s ends left hanging loose. Telex handles the quieter work, curvy and unclamped.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-tenor-sans: Commanding is how Bellota lands, with unshaded, constant strokes and an s whose tails hang loose from the stem. Tenor Sans then reads gently, its c tips never creeping together.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-tirra: Bellota hangs the ends of its s loose, with every stroke traced at stylus width. Tirra answers in sans form, round shapes like open parentheses, giving the heading's quirks some quiet space around them.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-titillium-web: Bellota draws horizontals as thick as its verticals, topped off with a loose-tailed s that looks nothing like its neighbor. Titillium Web keeps its stroke ends set apart.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-trispace: Zero stroke contrast runs through Bellota, from its dangling s to every stylus-width line it draws. Trispace sets sparse, widely spaced letters beneath, curves opening outward.
